propositions: Every structured-output consumer (library, CLI, MCP, in-tree) must route through the single authoritative PydanticAIRunner facade with one bounded-operation Agent run per output mode, replacing bespoke retry machinery.

The output-retry allowance N = min(OUTPUT_RETRIES, max(0, structured_retry_limit)) seeds both the Agent retries={"output":N} budget and the constructed UsageLimits request-limit addend, ensuring the output counter cannot trip before the request budget.
structured_retry_limit=0 must yield exactly zero output-repair retries (single-shot), preserving the single-attempt fail-safe in overlap/judge.py and contracts.py batch abstain.
A well-formed first response performs exactly one outer agent.run_sync invocation; the only sanctioned second run is the bug-895c native-to-prompted downgrade; never a third.
All in-tree consumers (enumerated by mode-resolving AST census, not text grep) including computed-mode instances must be verified to use the get_runner().run() facade without bypassing.
Provider fallback order, tool surfaces, timeout/transport limits, provenance, and serialized output shapes must remain unchanged from historical regressions.
